attr.title: Doki Doki Literature Club
attr.desc: Unofficial PortMaster port wrapper for Doki Doki Literature Club. Tuned for RK3326 handhelds such as R36S/R36H. Requires the user's own original DDLC 1.1.1 assets.
attr.desc_md: An unofficial PortMaster port wrapper for Doki Doki Literature Club. It includes a bundled Ren'Py 7.5.3 ARM runtime, R36S/R36H/RK3326 hardware profiles, handheld controls, virtual keyboard support, a virtual character file manager, local saves, and 16:9 / 4:3 display handling. Original DDLC assets are not included.
attr.inst: Copy your original DDLC 1.1.1 .rpa archives into ddlc/original/game and the four .chr files into ddlc/original/characters, then run DDLC.sh from Ports.
attr.inst_md: Copy your original DDLC 1.1.1 `.rpa` archives into `ddlc/original/game` and the four `.chr` files into `ddlc/original/characters`, then run `DDLC.sh` from Ports.
